notes: ShiftToken (src/ShiftToken.sol) is a self-contained fixed-supply ERC-20: name NIGHTSHIFT, symbol SHIFT, 18 decimals. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints the whole supply of 1,000,000,000 SHIFT (1000000000000000000000000000 minor units) once to msg.sender, which on the launch is the ProjectFactory; totalSupply() is a compile-time constant and nothing can mint or burn afterwards. Transfers move exactly the amount requested on every path: there is no fee, burn, tax, reflection, blocklist, pause, owner, minter, upgrade path, receive or fallback, so the token needs no exemptions for the factory, the pool manager or the distributor, and every launch flow arrives whole. The runtime contains no DELEGATECALL, CALLCODE or SELFDESTRUCT. There are no application contracts in this launch. The pool pairs SHIFT with IMD at the launch policy's 1.25% fee; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and the supply, and pool.initialPrice is provenance only.
